messages:
mira_sales: Quick sync  CipherField (regulated fintech) wants a short POC. They sent two variants: cipher-mini-int8 and cipher-guardian-qat. Ask: Dedicated with Hosted failover, target 30 qps steady, p95 <180ms for mini, <650ms for guardian. Also need SOC2 proof, BYO-KMS, and an agreed committed price. Looping @dan_engineering @priyanka_ml @ryan_ops @clare_security.

dan_engineering: Thanks. Can they confirm max sequence length, tokenizer type, and whether QAT includes fused/custom CUDA ops? Prefer a plain torch.load path and a tiny synthetic checkpoint (~50-150MB) to sanity-check loading.

mira_sales: They replied: max seq = 4096, tokenizer = HF BPE with a 3.5k vocab, and they flagged "fused attention" in the QAT model notes but said no third-party CUDA libs. They also require deterministic outputs for audit flows.

priyanka_ml: 4k seq + KV cache will influence memory footprint. If fused attention changes KV layout or mask semantics we need either an unfused checkpoint or an adapter. Request both fused and unfused loaders and a 200-example labeled eval set to verify determinism/regression.

ryan_ops: Infra notes: 30 qps batched suggests 1-2 optimized reserved nodes for mini and 2-3 for guardian depending on multi-card needs. BYO-KMS supported on Dedicated/Private; Hosted requires enterprise plan + onboarding ticket. I can run a cost sim once we know batch sizes and sequence distribution.

mira_sales: Can we give CipherField a rough committed price to include in their procurement packet?

ryan_ops: Quick ballpark: mini ~ "$9k/mo" (single optimized reserved), guardian ~ "$28k/mo" (multi-card reserve). We'll refine after perf profile.

priyanka_ml: Onboarding steps I recommend: (1) compatibility scan: load + forward checks; (2) perf profile: batching, KV/cache, seq mixes; (3) quant sweep/tune for mini; (4) canary on Dedicated then enable Hosted fallback. Owners: @dan_engineering (compat scan + profile), @priyanka_ml (quant/regression), @ryan_ops (infra & pricing), @clare_security (SQ answers).

dan_engineering: I'll need: s3 link to tokenizer, loader script, and a small checkpoint or a reproducible script to generate a synthetic checkpoint. Also share any special attention-mask behaviors.

clare_security: For the security questionnaire draft: key points  we do not persist customer prompts beyond configured retention windows by default; KV cache is ephemeral and not written to durable storage unless configured; audit logs are exportable to customer SIEM via log forwarder; BYO-KMS supported for Dedicated/Private; Hosted requires 2-3 week onboarding for enterprise KMS. Include SOC2 report link and pen test executive summary. I'll assemble answers focusing on retention, logs, and isolation.

mira_sales: CipherField also asked who runs deterministic/regression evals and if we can run them on their labeled set.

priyanka_ml: We can run their labeled eval if they provide it. Prefer a 200-example suite with expected outputs and deterministic seeds. We'll run regen + deterministic-sample checks and return a short report.

infra_bot: Reminder: planned maintenance Sat 04:00-05:00 UTC may interfere with Hosted fallback verification.

ryan_ops: Timeline proposal to CipherField: request artifacts today, expect compatibility scan Mon-Tue, perf + quant Wed, canary Dedicated Thu (if scans pass). KMS production onboarding ~2-3 weeks. Is that ok?

dan_engineering: Ack. I'll queue the scan and reserve time Mon-Tue. If fused ops require an adapter we may ask for an unfused checkpoint to avoid schedule slips.

clare_security: I'll draft SQ answers and attach SOC2 link + KMS timeline.

mira_sales: Thanks team  I'll post S3 links + their SQ next message once I have them. :thumbsup:
